title: Refactor Uri Mechanism To Repo Protocol
description: Refactor the URI mechanism and all specs of all entities to be repo://{{entity-kind}}/{{id}} e.g. repo://definition/🏘️compose📚go💻compose🛠️inverseConnectorDiff
summary:
Refactored all entity URIs from old hierarchical abbreviated format (repo://p/u/compose, repo://y/25/m/02/d/04/tk/slug, etc.) to flat emoji-based format repo://{{entity-kind}}/{{id}} (e.g., repo://definition/🏘️compose📚go💻compose🛠️inverseConnectorDiff).

Go CLI (main.go):
- Rewrote IdToUri to detect entity kind from emoji prefix and build repo://kind/id URIs
- Rewrote UriToId to extract ID from repo://kind/id format
- Rewrote GetArtifactURI to use IdToUri
- Updated all entity GetURI() methods
- Updated all MCP resource templates and handlers
- Updated all tree node URIs in BuildMonorepoTree
- Fixed DetectEntityKindFromId: singular/plural disambiguation via singularOrPlural helper, contributor emoji ordering before file checks
- Added path to definition tree node Data for VS Code navigation
- Removed dead ticketNodeToData URI parsing code

Go tests (main_test.go):
- Updated ~50 TestArtifactIDAndURI cases, ~22 TestIdToUri cases, ~22 TestUriToId cases, 11 TestIdUriRoundTrip cases
- Updated TestSectionHeaderIdAndUri, TestDefinitionHeaderIdAndUri, TestGetArtifactURI_Sessions/Session
- Updated TestSessionIdToUri, TestSessionUriToId, TestSessionGetURI, TestToolGoalUri
- Updated TestFormatHeader*, TestRenderMonorepoTree, TestRenderGoalTree, TestRenderSectionTree
- All URI-related tests pass

TypeScript (extension.ts):
- Updated navigateToUri to use tree node cache Data (path, sha, github, slug, startLine, endLine) instead of parsing emoji IDs as filesystem paths
- Simplified section/definition navigation to use node.Data.startLine/path directly
- Removed dead findSectionByPath function
- Added URI encoding for external URLs (GitHub contributor/checkpoint links)

SPECS (SPECS.md):
- Added URI Format specification section documenting the repo://kind/id format
- Updated GetURI spec to reference new format
